findings.title: Top bar text truncation
findings.problem: Text 'Practice arena — WASD/arrows drive, Space/J fire, Q/E cycle weapon. Seed a1tce5ee...' is cut off mid-sentence.
findings.why: Hides critical control instructions, leaving players confused about how to play.
findings.fix: Shorten non-essential text or wrap it to fit the screen, ensuring all control prompts are fully visible.

findings.title: Radar static and uninformative
findings.problem: Radar is a static black disc with a single green dot; no sweep animation or contacts.
findings.why: Fails to communicate surrounding threats/obstacles, breaking gameplay feedback for navigation and combat.
findings.fix: Add a rotating sweep animation and display nearby contacts (enemies, items) as moving dots.

findings.title: Constructor legal message low visibility
findings.problem: Small, unhighlighted text 'Name your car, then fit armor and at least one weapon to make it road-legal.' is hard to read.
findings.why: New players may not know to add weapons/armor, leading to confusion or inability to progress.
findings.fix: Highlight with a colored box, increase font size, or position above the car preview for better visibility.

findings.title: Title screen menu contrast
findings.problem: Menu text is white on dark background, blending into the box; low contrast.
findings.why: Interactive elements are hard to distinguish, leading to player confusion about navigation.
findings.fix: Add a lighter background tint or border around the menu box to improve text contrast.

findings.title: City screen lack of waypoints
findings.problem: No visual markers (arrows, path) to indicate route to Albany; only a vague circle.
findings.why: Navigation is unclear, making it difficult for players to understand their objective.
findings.fix: Add a glowing path or arrow markers from the car to Albany, visible on the city map.
